search_assistance: The search programs were written and run with Claude Code (Anthropic) under the direction of the repository author.
published_edge_format: n m header, then sorted undirected edges u v
graph_relation_to_discovery: The published labelling is the voltage-graph labelling 9u + 3x0 + x1 obtained by normalising the voltages of the Z3 x Z3 quotient along a spanning tree. It is isomorphic to the discovered orbit graph; orbit_graph_certificate.json gives the isomorphism, checked by check_isomorphism.py (and by nauty canonical forms).
